trigger: Husk encounter: a man in a T-shirt in the snow, trying to get into a car where a family shelters.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A man in a T-shirt. −15 °C. Hair coming out in clumps. He's pulling at a car door. Kids inside screaming.

nodes.speaker: husk
nodes.text: warm in there. it's warm in there. i'm so hot. why am i so hot.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He turns. Gums bleeding. His eyes track your coat, your bag, the heat coming off you.

nodes.speaker: dell
nodes.text: Hey. Hey. You're cold, not hot. It lies to you. Here. Put this on. Take these.

nodes.speaker: husk
nodes.text: ...cold. i'm cold. oh god. where's my coat. i had a coat.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He sits down in the snow and cries. The car door opens an inch. A woman: 'Bring him in. Bring him.'

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He has a farm cap. Esko Co-op. It's Pete Lund. He doesn't remember you.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He lunges for your bag. There's nothing in your hands that he understands.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He flinches, then comes at you. Fast. Faster than a sick man should.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He drops in the snow. The kids in the car keep screaming.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: When it's over, the family in the car won't open the door for you either.

nodes.speaker: theo
nodes.text: windows first. plastic and tape. i'll do the upstairs.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Ash ticks on the plastic, not the glass. The click from the street gets quieter.
